limitations.note: The agent correctly made the counter clocked, but it also removed the original `ready_b` guard, so the first accepted input of a group replaces `data_out` instead of adding to it when downstream is not ready.
The scoreboard restarted the sum after every four inputs, so it exercised downstream stalls but treated the agent’s changed behavior as correct rather than detecting the mismatch.
